verses.original: הֵ֥ן לְצֶ֖דֶק יִמְלָךְ־ מֶ֑לֶךְ וּלְשָׂרִ֖ים לְמִשְׁפָּ֥ט יָשֹֽׂרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hên lə·ṣe·ḏeq yim·lāḵ- me·leḵ ū·lə·śā·rîm lə·miš·pāṭ yā·śō·rū
verses.literal: Behold a king will reign in righteousness and princes will rule with justice
verses.literalPt: Eis que, em justiça, reinará um rei, e, em retidão, governarão príncipes.

verses.original: וְהָיָה־ אִ֥ישׁ כְּמַֽחֲבֵא־ ר֖וּחַ וְסֵ֣תֶר זָ֑רֶם כְּפַלְגֵי־ מַ֣יִם בְּצָי֔וֹן כְּצֵ֥ל סֶֽלַע־ כָּבֵ֖ד בְּאֶ֥רֶץ עֲיֵפָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh- ’îš kə·ma·ḥă·ḇê- rū·aḥ wə·sê·ṯer zā·rem kə·p̄al·ḡê- ma·yim bə·ṣā·yō·wn kə·ṣêl se·la‘- kā·ḇêḏ bə·’e·reṣ ‘ă·yê·p̄āh
verses.literal: Each will be like a shelter from the wind a refuge from the storm like streams of water in a dry land like the shadow of a great rock in an arid land
verses.literalPt: Um varão servirá de abrigo contra o vento, de esconderijo contra a tempestade, de rios de água numa terra árida e de sombra de uma grande penha numa terra sedenta.

verses.original: וְלֹ֥א תִשְׁעֶ֖ינָה עֵינֵ֣י רֹאִ֑ים וְאָזְנֵ֥י שֹׁמְעִ֖ים תִּקְשַֽׁבְנָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō ṯiš·‘e·nāh ‘ê·nê rō·’îm wə·’ā·zə·nê šō·mə·‘îm tiq·šaḇ·nāh
verses.literal: Then the eyes of those who see will no longer be closed and the ears of those who hear will listen
verses.literalPt: Os olhos dos que veem não se ofuscarão, e os ouvidos dos que ouvem escutarão.

verses.original: וּלְבַ֥ב נִמְהָרִ֖ים יָבִ֣ין לָדָ֑עַת וּלְשׁ֣וֹן עִלְּגִ֔ים תְּמַהֵ֖ר לְדַבֵּ֥ר צָחֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·ḇaḇ nim·hā·rîm yā·ḇîn lā·ḏā·‘aṯ ū·lə·šō·wn ‘il·lə·ḡîm tə·ma·hêr lə·ḏab·bêr ṣā·ḥō·wṯ
verses.literal: The mind of the rash will know and understand and the stammering tongue will speak clearly and fluently
verses.literalPt: Também o coração dos temerários entenderá o conhecimento, e a língua dos gagos estará pronta a falar distintamente.

verses.original: לֹֽא־ יִקָּרֵ֥א ע֛וֹד לְנָבָ֖ל נָדִ֑יב וּלְכִילַ֕י לֹ֥א יֵֽאָמֵ֖ר שֽׁוֹעַ׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yiq·qā·rê ‘ō·wḏ lə·nā·ḇāl nā·ḏîḇ ū·lə·ḵî·lay lō yê·’ā·mêr šō·w·a‘
verses.literal: No longer will a fool be called noble nor a scoundrel be respected
verses.literalPt: O tolo não será mais chamado nobre, nem o fraudulento será mais intitulado generoso.

verses.original: כִּ֤י נָבָל֙ נְבָלָ֣ה יְדַבֵּ֔ר וְלִבּ֖וֹ יַעֲשֶׂה־ אָ֑וֶן לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת חֹ֗נֶף וּלְדַבֵּ֤ר אֶל־ יְהוָה֙ תּוֹעָ֔ה לְהָרִיק֙ נֶ֣פֶשׁ רָעֵ֔ב וּמַשְׁקֶ֥ה צָמֵ֖א יַחְסִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: kî nā·ḇāl nə·ḇā·lāh yə·ḏab·bêr wə·lib·bōw ya·‘ă·śeh- ’ā·wen la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ḥō·nep̄ ū·lə·ḏab·bêr ’el- Yah·weh tō·w·‘āh lə·hā·rîq ne·p̄eš rā·‘êḇ ū·maš·qeh ṣā·mê yaḥ·sîr
verses.literal: For a fool speaks foolishness his mind plots iniquity He practices ungodliness and speaks falsely about the LORD he leaves the hungry . . . empty and deprives the thirsty of drink
verses.literalPt: Pois o tolo falará tolices, e o seu coração obrará a iniquidade, para praticar a profanidade e proferir erros contra Jeová, para deixar vazia a alma do faminto e fazer faltar a bebida ao sedento.

verses.original: וְכֵלַ֖י כֵּלָ֣יו רָעִ֑ים ה֚וּא זִמּ֣וֹת יָעָ֔ץ לְחַבֵּ֤ל עֲנָוִים בְּאִמְרֵי־ שֶׁ֔קֶר וּבְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶבְי֖וֹן מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵê·lay kê·lāw rā·‘îm hū zim·mō·wṯ yā·‘āṣ lə·ḥab·bêl ʿă·nå̄·wīm bə·’im·rê- še·qer ū·ḇə·ḏab·bêr ’eḇ·yō·wn miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: The weapons of the scoundrel are destructive he hatches plots to destroy the poor with lies . . . even when the plea of the needy is just
verses.literalPt: Também as maquinações do fraudulento são más; é ele quem forma planos sinistros para perder os mansos com palavras mentirosas, ainda quando o pobre fala o que é justo.

verses.original: וְנָדִ֖יב נְדִיב֣וֹת יָעָ֑ץ וְה֖וּא עַל־ נְדִיב֥וֹת יָקֽוּם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ḏîḇ nə·ḏî·ḇō·wṯ yā·‘āṣ wə·hū ‘al- nə·ḏî·ḇō·wṯ yā·qūm
verses.literal: But a noble man makes honorable plans he stands up for worthy causes
verses.literalPt: O nobre, porém, forma planos nobres e neles permanecerá.

verses.original: נָשִׁים֙ שַֽׁאֲנַנּ֔וֹת קֹ֖מְנָה שְׁמַ֣עְנָה קוֹלִ֑י בָּנוֹת֙ בֹּֽטח֔וֹת הַאְזֵ֖נָּה אִמְרָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: nā·šîm ša·’ă·nan·nō·wṯ qō·mə·nāh šə·ma‘·nāh qō·w·lî bā·nō·wṯ bō·ṭ·ḥō·wṯ ha’·zên·nāh ’im·rā·ṯî
verses.literal: Stand up you complacent women listen to me . . . Give ear to my word you overconfident daughters
verses.literalPt: Levantai-vos, mulheres indolentes, e ouvi a minha voz; escutai, filhas descuidadas, o meu discurso.

verses.original: יָמִים֙ עַל־ שָׁנָ֔ה תִּרְגַּ֖זְנָה בֹּֽטְח֑וֹת כִּ֚י כָּלָ֣ה בָצִ֔יר אֹ֖סֶף בְּלִ֥י יָבֽוֹא׃
verses.transliteration: yā·mîm ‘al- šā·nāh tir·gaz·nāh bō·ṭə·ḥō·wṯ kî kā·lāh ḇā·ṣîr ’ō·sep̄ bə·lî yā·ḇō·w
verses.literal: In a little more than . . . a year you will tremble O secure ones For the grape harvest will fail and the fruit harvest will not arrive
verses.literalPt: Num ano e dias, sereis perturbadas, mulheres descuidadas, pois a vindima está consumida, e não virá a colheita.

verses.original: חִרְדוּ֙ שַֽׁאֲנַנּ֔וֹת רְגָ֖זָה בֹּֽטְח֑וֹת פְּשֹׁ֣טָֽה וְעֹ֔רָה וַחֲג֖וֹרָה עַל־ חֲלָצָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ḥir·ḏū ša·’ă·nan·nō·wṯ rə·ḡā·zāh bō·ṭə·ḥō·wṯ pə·šō·ṭāh wə·‘ō·rāh wa·ḥă·ḡō·w·rāh ‘al- ḥă·lā·ṣā·yim
verses.literal: Shudder you ladies of leisure tremble you daughters of complacency Strip yourselves bare and put sackcloth around your waists
verses.literalPt: Tremei, mulheres indolentes, turbai-vos, ó descuidadas; despi-vos, ponde-vos nuas e cingi de saco os vossos lombos.

verses.original: עַל־ שָׁדַ֖יִם סֹֽפְדִ֑ים עַל־ שְׂדֵי־ חֶ֕מֶד עַל־ גֶּ֖פֶן פֹּרִיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- šā·ḏa·yim sō·p̄ə·ḏîm ‘al- śə·ḏê- ḥe·meḏ ‘al- ge·p̄en pō·rî·yāh
verses.literal: Beat your breasts for the pleasant . . . fields for the fruitful vines
verses.literalPt: Baterão nos seus peitos por causa dos campos aprazíveis, por causa da vinha frutífera.

verses.original: עַ֚ל אַדְמַ֣ת עַמִּ֔י ק֥וֹץ שָׁמִ֖יר תַּֽעֲלֶ֑ה כִּ֚י עַל־ כָּל־ בָּתֵּ֣י מָשׂ֔וֹשׂ קִרְיָ֖ה עַלִּיזָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al ’aḏ·maṯ ‘am·mî qō·wṣ šā·mîr ta·‘ă·leh kî ‘al- kāl- bāt·tê mā·śō·wś qir·yāh ‘al·lî·zāh
verses.literal: and for the land of my people overgrown with thorns and briers even for every house of merriment in this city of revelry
verses.literalPt: Espinhos e abrolhos virão sobre a terra do meu povo, sobre todas as casas de alegria, numa cidade jubilosa.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אַרְמ֣וֹן נֻטָּ֔שׁ הֲמ֥וֹן עִ֖יר עֻזָּ֑ב עֹ֣פֶל וָבַ֜חַן הָיָ֨ה בְעַ֤ד מְעָרוֹת֙ עַד־ עוֹלָ֔ם מְשׂ֥וֹשׂ פְּרָאִ֖ים מִרְעֵ֥ה עֲדָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ar·mō·wn nuṭ·ṭāš hă·mō·wn ‘îr ‘uz·zāḇ ‘ō·p̄el wā·ḇa·ḥan hā·yāh ḇə·‘aḏ mə·‘ā·rō·wṯ ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām mə·śō·wś pə·rā·’îm mir·‘êh ‘ă·ḏā·rîm
verses.literal: For the palace will be forsaken the busy city abandoned The hill and the watchtower will become caves forever . . . the delight of wild donkeys and a pasture for flocks
verses.literalPt: O palácio será abandonado; a cidade populosa ficará deserta; o outeiro e a atalaia servirão de covis para sempre, folga dos asnos monteses e pasto dos rebanhos;

verses.original: עַד־ יֵ֨עָרֶ֥ה עָלֵ֛ינוּ ר֖וּחַ מִמָּר֑וֹם וְהָיָ֤ה מִדְבָּר֙ לַכַּרְמֶ֔ל וְכַרְמֶל לַיַּ֥עַר יֵחָשֵֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ- yê·‘ā·reh ‘ā·lê·nū rū·aḥ mim·mā·rō·wm wə·hā·yāh miḏ·bār lak·kar·mel wə·ḵar·mɛl lay·ya·‘ar yê·ḥā·šêḇ
verses.literal: until the Spirit is poured out upon us from on high Then the desert will be an orchard and the orchard will seem like a forest
verses.literalPt: até que sobre nós se derrame o Espírito lá do alto, o deserto se torne em campo fértil e o campo fértil seja reputado por um bosque.

verses.original: וְשָׁכַ֥ן בַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה בַּכַּרְמֶ֥ל תֵּשֵֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·ḵan bam·miḏ·bār miš·pāṭ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh bak·kar·mel tê·šêḇ
verses.literal: Then justice will inhabit the wilderness and righteousness will dwell in the fertile field
verses.literalPt: Então, o juízo habitará no deserto, e a justiça morará no campo fértil.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֛ה מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה הַצְּדָקָ֖ה שָׁל֑וֹם וַֽעֲבֹדַת֙ הַצְּדָקָ֔ה הַשְׁקֵ֥ט וָבֶ֖טַח עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ma·‘ă·śêh haṣ·ṣə·ḏā·qāh šā·lō·wm wa·‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ haṣ·ṣə·ḏā·qāh haš·qêṭ wā·ḇe·ṭaḥ ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: The work of righteousness will be peace the service of righteousness will be quiet confidence forever . . .
verses.literalPt: A obra da justiça será a paz; e o efeito da justiça será o sossego e confiança para sempre.

verses.original: וְיָשַׁ֥ב עַמִּ֖י בִּנְוֵ֣ה שָׁל֑וֹם וּֽבְמִשְׁכְּנוֹת֙ מִבְטַחִ֔ים וּבִמְנוּחֹ֖ת שַׁאֲנַנּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·šaḇ ‘am·mî bin·wêh šā·lō·wm ū·ḇə·miš·kə·nō·wṯ miḇ·ṭa·ḥîm ū·ḇim·nū·ḥōṯ ša·’ă·nan·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: Then my people will dwell in a peaceful . . . place in safe and secure places of rest
verses.literalPt: O meu povo habitará em morada de paz e em lugares quietos de descanso.

verses.original: וּבָרַ֖ד בְּרֶ֣דֶת הַיָּ֑עַר וּבַשִּׁפְלָ֖ה תִּשְׁפַּ֥ל הָעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·raḏ bə·re·ḏeṯ hay·yā·‘ar ū·ḇaš·šip̄·lāh tiš·pal hā·‘îr
verses.literal: But hail will level the forest and the city will sink to the depths
verses.literalPt: Mas haverá saraiva quando cair o bosque, e a cidade será de todo abatida.

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵיכֶ֕ם זֹרְעֵ֖י עַל־ כָּל־ מָ֑יִם מְשַׁלְּחֵ֥י רֶֽגֶל־ הַשּׁ֖וֹר וְהַחֲמֽוֹר׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’aš·rê·ḵem zō·rə·‘ê ‘al- kāl- mā·yim mə·šal·lə·ḥê re·ḡel- haš·šō·wr wə·ha·ḥă·mō·wr
verses.literal: Blessed are those who sow beside abundant waters who let the ox and donkey range freely . . .
verses.literalPt: Felizes sois vós os que semeais junto a todas as águas, que deixais livres os pés do boi e do jumento.
